purpose: Test whether causally available Census M3 manufacturing operating-state information improves industry/security selection or creates an orthogonal portfolio role relative to the incumbent P249+P266 return core.

causality.signal_observation_rule: A monthly M3 observation may affect a portfolio decision only after its official publication is observable. Never use the observation month-end as availability time.
causality.release_availability_lag: Use the first investable session strictly after the official M3 publication timestamp/date for that release. If only publication date is available, trade no earlier than the next full U.S. session.
causality.vintage_revision_rule: For promotion-quality evidence use point-in-time vintage values when an authoritative vintage history is available. If only the latest revised history is available, classify the run REPRESENTATION_NOT_PROMOTION_SAFE and do not treat performance as promotion-quality alpha evidence.
causality.missing_release_rule: Carry the last causally available published state until the next release; never backfill future releases into prior dates.

frozen_industry_state_inputs.feature_rule: All transformations are trailing-only and computed from causally available released observations. No post-result category, measure, lag, window, threshold, or security substitution.

industry_score.construction: Equal-weight the four standardized derived features after orienting inventory-to-shipments change negatively; require at least three finite components.
industry_score.selection: At each release, rank the four frozen categories by industry_score. Long only the top category proxy/security basket when its score is positive; otherwise hold benchmark-neutral cash for the challenger sleeve.

security_selection.primary_test: Within the winning category, equal-weight the frozen security_universe_hint members that have complete causal price history and pass the fixed liquidity gate.
security_selection.liquidity_gate: Median trailing 60-session dollar volume >= 20,000,000 USD using only information available before rebalance.
security_selection.survivorship_rule: Promotion-quality stock-level evidence requires point-in-time constituent/security eligibility. If unavailable, report proxy-level results as causal and stock-level results as exploratory only.
security_selection.rebalance: First full U.S. session after each causally available M3 release; hold until next eligible release.

controls_and_costs.cash_return: 0 for challenger-isolation test; common-sample portfolio consumer may apply its canonical cash convention without changing the challenger signal.

validation.chronology: Strict release-time chronology; no same-release lookahead.
validation.oos: Use expanding-window chronological evaluation with at least 5 contiguous folds when sample length permits; report fold-level matched excess.
promotion_gates: positive after-cost CAGR excess versus the best matched simple control on the exact common sample
positive excess in at least 3/5 chronological folds when five folds are feasible
does not rely on a single category for more than 70% of total excess contribution
survives 25 bps/side stress without losing all matched excess
point-in-time/vintage safety is satisfied for any promotion-quality claim

downstream.if_supported: Run unchanged common-sample opportunity-cost consumer against P249+P266; do not replace incumbent on standalone return alone.
downstream.if_risk_only: Route to risk-shaping tournament, not return-alpha capital.
downstream.if_not_supported: Park the scientific child; no category/measure/lag/mapping/window/ticker rescue.
